{{Quote|I represent the only legitimate local government, and we've been fighting off both the Alliance and the Imps for six months!|[[Elscol Loro]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 1">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 1|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Cilpari Resistance''' was a movement of freedom fighters loosely associated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that successfully fought to liberate [[Cilpar]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control about one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==History==
The resistance was led by [[Throm Loro]] until [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of the Cliffs]], after which his widow, [[Elscol Loro]], assumed control of the group. The movement was supported by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]: [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] served as the official Alliance contact to the group, and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and his [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] provided additional support after becoming stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during a routine escort mission.<ref name="The Rebel Opposition" />

The movement was ultimately [[Mission to Cilpar|successful]] after the Cilpari Resistance, with the help of Antilles, successfully wrested control of the planet from [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boren Tascl]] and [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Norquest]] despite the meddling of [[Vance Rego]], an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] within the resistance. [[Groznik]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Life debt/Legends|life-debted]] to Throm and Elscol Loro, also played a part in the group's success.<ref name="The Rebel Opposition" /> The Cilpari Resistance served as a precursor to Elscol Loro's later career, in which she and other anti-Empire helped liberate and overthrow Imperial planetary governments with no official connection to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
